aperture_validity.basis: the imported aperture stop is a plate whose opening is the stated stop semi-diameter
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: eligibility only: this record asserts no field point, pupil sample or illumination measurement, so no stop-dependent match is claimed

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: PROJECT_DECLARED vacuum wavelength from the native source.
spectrum.wavelength_precision: Native d-line in vacuum, converted from 587.56 nm in air at 20 C and 101325 Pa.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: a set of enabled wavelengths is sampling evidence; the source states no continuous range

image_format.sensor_format: not stated by the source; the source prints a maximum image height of 9.20 mm, i.e. a 18.4 mm image circle
image_format.basis: SOURCE_STATED: the source prints the maximum image height Y = 9.20 mm, so the image circle is 2Y

back_focal_length_mm.definition: from the last surface vertex to the paraxial image point

total_track_mm.definition: first surface vertex to the image plane along the axis
total_track_mm.derivation: the sum of the transcribed surface thicknesses from the first surface to the image plane; the source prints no total length of its own

engine_check.method: thick-lens paraxial ABCD through the committed Project's COMPOUND unit

f_number.definition: image-space f-number stated by the source

stop_semi_diameter_mm.definition: semi-diameter of the aperture stop the Project carries
stop_semi_diameter_mm.basis: DERIVED: the paraxial stop height of the axial ray whose entrance pupil diameter is EFL / f-number

field.definition: object-space half field angle to the edge of the image circle; the source states the full field 2w

catalog_comparisons.note: no published glass reproduces both stated constants inside the tolerance; the medium is modelled as a constant index at the stated nd and the nearest published glass is recorded for comparison only

materials.note: A medium the source names is used as published. A medium the source gives only as (nd, Vd) is the catalog glass that reproduces both constants inside nd 5e-5 and Vd 0.05, recorded with the difference; no other glass is substituted.
materials.policy: Each glass is the nearest published catalog glass resolved from the publication's printed nd and vd; materials.catalog_comparisons records the resolved glass and its index and Abbe difference, and the committed Project carries that catalog glass's own dispersion curve. The publication prints no per-surface index table, so this resolved catalog material is the material model.

application_facts.note: a fixed-focus lens for factory automation / machine vision inspection; the source states no working distance, magnification or telecentricity

approximations.description: Surfaces 16, 17 are the source's parallel flat plate (the optical member PP, 'a member assumed to be various filters, cover glass, or the like') and the back space behind it; they are kept as prescribed. The source's Bf is the air-converted distance from the last lens surface (15) to the image plane, so it excludes the plate; the printed plate chain reproduces it as an air-equivalent distance to 22.8103 mm against the stated 22.81 mm, i.e. within the printed rounding.

No published catalog glass reproduces both constants of 1.85151/40.73 inside nd 5e-5 / vd 0.05, so each of those media is carried as a constant index at its source-stated nd, stated relative to air; its dispersion is not modelled and only the d-line paraxial quantities are affected by the omission.

The source states no clear aperture. Each surface's clear semi-diameter is the largest paraxial footprint of the axial marginal ray at the stated aperture and, where an object field is stated, the chief ray of the widest sampled field plus half the off-axis beam radius; a mechanical value, not a source fact.

provenance.table_locator: TABLE 1 (basic lens data) and TABLE 2 (specifications), infinity-focus state
provenance.transcription: surface radius, thickness, nd and vd read from the basic lens data table; f, Bf, FNo., 2w and the maximum image height Y read from the specification table; the plane-parallel plate is kept as printed. The source prints an effective diameter ED for the last lens surface only; it is not used, so every clear aperture in this record is derived
